objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every pull_request/push workflow (deploy, docs-site, tests) got a deliberate trigger decision, and the required `unit-tests` check was given exactly the correct single-workflow shape — no workflow-level paths/paths-ignore, salience computed in a `changes` job output gating the real job via `if:`, with no companion skip-workflow duplicating the check name, so no cap applies.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's paths are tailored to what it actually consumes (deploy: src + runtime deps + deploy.sh; docs-site: docs/** + mkdocs.yml; tests change-filter: src/test/package files) plus the workflow file itself, matching the in-file comments rather than copying a sibling, though the exact `test` dir name and deploy.sh usage can't be fully verified from the diff.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The diff touches only the three workflows needing trigger decisions, leaving the schedule-only nightly-sweep, issue-driven triage, and the main.json ruleset entirely untouched, and nothing was committed.
